;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Operations Claw-Eagle and Claw-Tiger]]
**Five [[Kurds|Kurdish]] civilians near [[Dohuk]] in the [[Kurdistan Region]] of [[Iraq]] are killed by [[Turkish Armed Forces|Turkish]] [[airstrike]]s. [https://news.yahoo.com/turkey-air-raids-kill-5-civilians-north-iraq-164642137.html (AFP)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]]'s [[Ministry of Health (Brazil)|Ministry of Health]] reports 54,771 new cases and that there are now 1,032,913 confirmed cases of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] in the country, becoming the second country in the world, after the [[United States]], to surpass one million cases. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-53092196 (BBC News)] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-06-19/brazil-blows-past-1-million-infections-with-no-peak-in-sight (Bloomberg)]

;International relations
*[[Nuclear program of Iran]]
**The [[International Atomic Energy Agency]] (IAEA) passes a resolution, the first since 2012, calling on [[Iran]] to open two of its nuclear sites to international inspectors. Iran strongly opposes the IAEA resolution, which it says was "based on false allegations" from [[Israel]]. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/un-nuclear-watchdog-calls-iran-open-suspected-sites-investigation (''Middle East Eye'')] 
*The [[Caribbean Community]] (CARICOM) says "sorry is not enough" from British financial institutions that benefited from the [[Atlantic slave trade]], and demands reparations from the [[United Kingdom]]. This comes after the [[Bank of England]] apologized for the "inexcusable connections" of some of its past governors and directors to [[slavery]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-minneapolis-police-protests-britain-c/exclusive-sorry-is-not-enough-caribbean-states-say-of-british-slavery-apologies-idUKKBN23Q10V (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Zimbabwe]]
**Health Minister [[Obadiah Moyo]] is arrested and accused of corruption in [[Government of Zimbabwe|government]] procurement of around $60 million worth of medical equipment. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-zimbabwe-crime/zimbabwe-health-minister-arrested-over-60-million-covid-19-equipment-contract-media-reports-idUSKBN23Q33D?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Killing of Breonna Taylor]]
**[[Louisville, Kentucky|Louisville]] Mayor [[Greg Fischer]] announces the immediate termination of [[Louisville Metro Police Department|LMPD]] Officer Brett Hankison over violating departmental policy on the use of force against [[Breonna Taylor]]. Hankison is one of three officers involved in the shooting, and prior to the incident had previously been investigated and disciplined for alleged [[police misconduct|misconduct]]. [https://www.courier-journal.com/story/news/politics/metro-government/2020/06/19/breonna-taylor-protests-brett-hankison-fired-lmpd/3222004001/ (''The Courier-Journal'')]
*[[Abortion in Tennessee]], [[Heartbeat bill]]
**Lawmakers in the [[U.S. state]] of [[Tennessee]] pass the country's toughest anti-[[abortion]] laws, banning the procedure from the moment of fetal heartbeat at around six weeks of pregnancy. [[Governor of Tennessee|Governor]] [[Bill Lee (Tennessee politician)|Bill Lee]] hails the law while several organizations say they plan to go to the courts over the issue. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-abortion-tennessee/tennessee-lawmakers-pass-heartbeat-abortion-bill-banning-procedure-after-six-weeks-idUSKBN23Q2Z9?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Shooting of Matthew Hunt]]
**A [[New Zealand Police|police]] officer is killed and another seriously injured in a shooting in [[Massey, New Zealand]]. This is the first time a law enforcement officer in [[New Zealand]] has been killed in the line of duty since [[Napier shootings|2009]]. The shooter fled, injuring a civilian in the process, but he has since been arrested. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-53102988 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Belarusian presidential election]]
**[[President of Belarus|President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] announces the arrest of main opposition rival [[Viktar Babaryka]] for possible financial crimes. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2020/06/19/belarus-leaders-election-rival-detained-as-crackdown-intensifies-a70619 (''Moscow Times'')]
*[[2020 Hong Kong legislative election]]
**Activist [[Joshua Wong]] announces he is running for the legislature, setting up a new legal battle with authorities after he was barred from running in the previous election. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-protests-joshua-wong/activist-joshua-wong-says-he-plans-to-run-for-hong-kong-legislature-idUSKBN23Q1RK (Reuters)]
*Tens of thousands of protesters descend on the [[Mali]]an capital of [[Bamako]], demanding [[President of Mali|President]] [[Ibrahim Boubacar Keïta]] resign over his failure to solve the country's myriad of problems. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mali-politics-protests/thousands-of-protesters-demand-mali-president-step-down-idUSKBN23Q334?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*The world’s second-largest egg is discovered on [[Seymour Island]], [[Antarctica]]. The egg, which is also the very first [[fossil egg]] from Antarctica and the largest soft-shelled egg ever discovered, may challenge the notion that [[mosasaurs]] and [[plesiosaurs]] were fully [[viviparous]] according to scientists. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/technology/giant-egg-antarctica-1.5619145 (CBC)]

;Sports
*Numerous professional wrestlers and others in the [[professional wrestling]] industry, particularly in the [[Professional wrestling in the United Kingdom|United Kingdom]], are accused of sexual abuse, sexual misconduct and other forms of physical and mental abuse on social media, using the [[Hashtag activism|hashtag]] #SpeakingOut. [https://www.si.com/wrestling/2020/06/19/hashtag-speaking-out-wrestling-industry-abusive-behavior (''Sports Illustrated'')]
**[[WWE]] releases a statement, indicating a "zero tolerance" policy on several types of abuse, and later in the day come to terms on the release of [[Gentleman Jack Gallagher]] after he is accused of sexual assault [https://www.f4wonline.com/wwe-news/wwe-releases-jack-gallagher-following-sexual-assault-claim-313701 (''Wrestling Observer/Figure Four Online'')]
**[[All Elite Wrestling]] release a statement saying that [[Jimmy Havoc]] has entered a rehabilitation facility and will evaluate his status in the company after his treatment is completed, after he is accused of domestic abuse and rape, and of punching a fan. [https://www.f4wonline.com/aew-news/aew-issues-statement-jimmy-havoc-allegations-313696 (''Wrestling Observer/Figure Four Online'')]
**The [[National Wrestling Alliance]] announces that Vice President Dave Lagana has resigned from the company after he is accused of sexual assault. [https://www.prowrestlingsheet.com/david-lagana-resigns-nwa-sexual-assault-allegation/ (''Pro Wrestling Sheet'')]
